we are writeing a mailchimp article about this, can you condense it and make it coming from alighment nashville: How do you find out what’s happening in your community?
When a school board rezones a neighborhood, local news is how families find out in time to respond. When a health clinic opens, it’s how neighbors learn it exists. When disaster strikes, it’s how people know where to go, what to do, and how to stay safe.
That kind of information shapes real decisions every day.
But it only works if it’s reaching people in ways that are timely, relevant, and easy to access.
Right now, access to local information isn’t equal across Middle Tennessee. Some communities have strong, reliable ways to stay informed. Others face real gaps.
Press Forward Middle Tennessee is working to better understand that landscape—and we need to hear directly from you.
We’re helping share a short, 8-10 minute survey to learn:
How you get local news and information
What sources you trust
Where information is missing or hard to find
Your input will help guide future support for local news and community information across all 40 counties in our region. That includes where resources are invested, what gets strengthened, and how communities stay connected.
This work is made possible by the Community Foundation of Middle Tennessee and The Healing Trust, with research support from The Sycamore Institute.
